value.rationale: A motivated concrete algorithmic resolution of the explicitly requested finite-k Gibbs fragmentation sampling problem: exact pairwise transition probabilities with rational calculations, simultaneous simulation of all layers, and the ability to reproduce exact marginal and refinement probabilities. This is stronger than the generic qualitative existence theorem. The classical primitive recursion itself is not claimed as a standalone contribution.
